TTRPG Experiment 4 - Kitbashing

11/9/26

Kitbashing is a schism-inducing map-making RPG about four separate worlds being torn up and pushed together.

I didn't get very far in the writing of prompts, but it uses a 52-card system similar to A Quiet Year.
